keyFindings.description: The consumer filter is set from the first plan and never set again after UpsertPlanned re-plans on a CAS conflict and stores a different row, so the filter and the row disagree, breaking interest.go's own promise. With two registrations of one session racing (a heartbeat and an envoy_subscribe; or an abandoned request whose consumer update still lands) the row can say C is followed while the filter lacks C, and messages on C are skipped until the next heartbeat. Move the bounded plan/register/write loop into subscribeHandler (the store's write then a single CAS of the planned row returning a conflict), or hold the session lock across plan, filter and write.
